meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先分析你的需求，推断出合适的设计方向，然后生成不套模板的落地页、作品集或改版界面。它会根据设计读盘选择真实的设计系统或原生 CSS，并遵循严格的前置检查。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建或重新设计落地页、作品集、品牌页面，或要求生成前端代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 B2B SaaS 落地页，风格像 Linear。
say.note: Claude 会先输出一行设计读盘，然后生成代码。

say.text: 给我的设计师作品集做个改版，保留现有品牌色。
say.note: Claude 会先审计现有设计，再输出改版方案。

say.text: 做一个创意工作室的首页，偏向 Awwwards 风格。
say.note: Claude 会调高设计方差和动感强度，生成实验性布局。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads your brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. It picks real design systems when applicable, audits first on redesigns, and runs a strict pre-flight check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create or redesign a landing page, portfolio, brand page, or generate frontend code.

say_en.text: Design a B2B SaaS landing page in Linear style.
say_en.note: Claude will output a design read line first, then generate code.

say_en.text: Redesign my designer portfolio, preserving existing brand colors.
say_en.note: Claude will audit the current design first, then output the redesign.

say_en.text: Create a creative studio homepage with an Awwwards vibe.
